notes: Syncro agent install, safer: TM Toolset now DOWNLOADS the installer from Syncro, verifies it's signed by Servably, and saves it to your Downloads folder — then you run it yourself (Open folder / Run installer). It no longer runs it silently in the background (that only unpacked files without installing the service). If a previous attempt left a C:\Program Files\RepairTech\Syncro folder with no running service, you can delete that folder, then run the downloaded installer for a clean install.
